# deps/undeclared-import

Import of a package that package.json does not declare.

A bare import (import, export from, require, or dynamic import) of a package that the nearest package.json, the root package.json, and the workspace packages do not declare.

- Default level: `warn`.
- Levels: block in diff mode when node_modules exists and the package is not in it, because the import cannot resolve; warn when the package is installed through another dependency, when there is no node_modules, for type-only imports, and in examples, docs, and Deno code. Example, template, and docs folders without their own package.json are skipped, and so are dependencies of other workspace members when npm, Yarn (node_modules), or Bun hoists them.
- Looks at: the project as a whole, across files.
- References: [CWE-1357](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1357.html), OWASP A03:2025.

## Why it matters

An undeclared package works only by accident, because another dependency installed it, or not at all. Agents often import packages they never added, and installing such a name later without checking it is how invented package names get installed.

## Flagged

`src/app/page.tsx` (warn):

```tsx
import get from 'lodash/get';
```

`src/app/page.tsx` (warn):

```tsx
import dayjs from 'dayjs';
```

`src/app/page.tsx` (warn):

```tsx
import type { ZodSchema } from 'zod';
```

`src/app/page.tsx` (warn):

```tsx
export * from 'ramda';
```

`src/app/page.tsx` (warn):

```tsx
const ky = await import('ky');
```

`src/app/page.tsx` (warn):

```tsx
const chalk = require('chalk');
```

`supabase/functions/summarize/index.ts` (warn):

```ts
import { cors } from 'hono-cors-helper';
```

`tests/cart.test.ts` (warn):

```ts
import { setupServer } from 'msw/node';
```

## Not flagged

- `import React from 'react';` in `src/app/page.tsx`: declared in package.json
- `import Link from 'next/link';` in `src/app/page.tsx`: subpath of the declared next package
- `import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js/dist/main/index.js';` in `src/app/page.tsx`: deep import of a declared scoped package
- `import fs from 'node:fs';` in `src/app/page.tsx`: Node built-in with node:
- `import path from 'path';` in `src/app/page.tsx`: Node built-in without node:
- `import { readFile } from 'fs/promises';` in `src/app/page.tsx`: Node built-in subpath
- `import { Button } from '@/components/button';` in `src/app/page.tsx`: tsconfig path alias
- `import { money } from '~lib/money';` in `src/app/page.tsx`: tsconfig path alias with a ~ prefix
- `import Header from '@ui/header';` in `src/app/page.tsx`: bundler alias in vitest.config.ts
- `import { commit } from 'build-info';` in `src/app/page.tsx`: declared with declare module in a .d.ts file

## How to fix

Add the package with your package manager after checking it with `ubon vet <name>`, or import something the project already depends on.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore deps/undeclared-import: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "deps/undeclared-import": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
